Our Story

Recipes Passed Down. Cooked With Love.

Mama Lou started cooking for this neighborhood out of her own kitchen. Thirty years later, her grandbabies are learning the same recipes at the same stove — measured by hand, seasoned by memory, and tasted before anything leaves the kitchen.

🏠

Family Owned & Run

When you walk in, you’re likely to be greeted by family — because everybody working here is. That’s been true since 1994.

📖

Grandma’s Recipes

The fried chicken brine, the mac & cheese blend, the cobbler crust — written down by Mama Lou and guarded like family treasure.

❤️

Cooked With Love

Nothing frozen, nothing rushed. Greens simmer for hours, chicken brines overnight, and cobbler comes out of the oven every morning.

Come Hungry

Inside Mama Lou’s

Red checkered tablecloths, plates steaming when they hit the table, and a dining room that feels like family reunion every day of the week.
